scientific_integrity: Proof supplied for every integer quadruple; 625 exact finite tests supplement, but do not replace, the proof. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-zero smooth complete toric threefold family only. The finite band is necessary, not sufficient; pairwise separation is only under toric isomorphism. Unindexed equivalent four-parameter tables may exist.
title: A closed four-parameter canonical tensor-generation test for the Fujino–Sato toric threefolds
